claims.claim: The card that holds your place has a folded top-trailing corner

claims.claim: Middlemarch's cover has a folded corner on Today and on its detail screen
claims.evidence: today.png: the Middlemarch 'M' cover in Currently Reading has a folded top-right corner and the Walden cover does not; book.png: the large cover has the same fold

claims.claim: Today, Library, Stats in one glass capsule, Search as the separate trailing search tab
claims.evidence: today.png, book.png, empty.png: a capsule at the bottom holds Today/Library/Stats, with a separate round magnifier button on the right

claims.claim: "Log Pages" on Today is a text item in the top toolbar ... On the book screen it is a secondary button
claims.evidence: today.png: a 'Log Pages' pill sits top-right under the status bar; book.png: 'Log Pages' is a grey secondary button under Start Session

claims.claim: Start Session on Today resumes the most recently read book (Middlemarch, from page 312); the caption under the button says so
claims.evidence: today.png: the caption 'Middlemarch · from page 312' sits directly under the green Start Session button

claims.claim: First seen: today's minutes against the goal and the streak; second: Start Session; third: the week and the books
claims.evidence: today.png: from top to bottom: '12 of 20 min' plus the '4 days' streak, then Start Session, then This Week, then Currently Reading

claims.claim: under-goal days are a lighter green ... today is hatched as in progress; a "Met goal" key sits next to the goal-line key. Values are always printed
claims.evidence: today.png This Week: Mon/Thu/Sat bars are dark, Tue/Fri are lighter and Today is hatched; the 'Met goal' and '--- Goal 20 min' keys are shown; values 24,18,0,31,18,22,12 are printed above the bars

claims.claim: The More menu (ellipsis, toolbar trailing) ... It is a system menu, closed in the render
claims.evidence: book.png: a round ellipsis button sits top-right; no menu is open

claims.claim: Book detail is pushed from Today ... so the Today tab stays selected and the back button returns to Today
claims.evidence: book.png: a back chevron is at top-left and the Today tab is highlighted in the tab bar; that the button returns to Today is behaviour and can't be seen in a render

claims.claim: The floating tab bar sits with its bottom edge 38 pt above the screen edge ... so nothing interactive sits in the 34-pt home-indicator inset
claims.evidence: today.png/book.png/empty.png: the tab bar's bottom edge is at about 1670 px of 1748 (≈39 pt from the bottom), above the home indicator; nothing interactive sits in the bottom inset

claims.claim: First-run screen: no toolbar `plus` ... the tabs stay visible and enabled
claims.evidence: empty.png: there is no toolbar button under the status bar; the tab bar is shown at full opacity with Today selected

claims.claim: Visible text above the tab bar measures at or above AA
claims.evidence: facts.md: book.html and empty.html have 0 failures; today.html's only failure is the 10px tab label span 'Today' (2.68:1), which is inside the tab bar, not above it

notes: The claim about text above the tab bar holds, but facts.md shows the 'Today' tab label itself fails AA on today.html (2.68:1). The brief requires AA for all text, including text on translucent surfaces. Content the notes place below the fold (the Today highlight, the Book highlights, The Pillow Book row) is not visible on the first screen and so can't be checked.
